trigger: POST an auth route whose real identifier is not email (e.g. /auth/local) varying body.email
exploit_path: each distinct body.email yields a fresh rate-limit bucket, so brute-force against a fixed account evades the per-IP throttle
notes: buildPrefixKey drops the routeUsesEmailIdentifier gate; helper left as dead code

trigger: admin password reset while an attacker holds a pre-existing active refresh session
exploit_path: sessions are not invalidated on reset so a stolen session survives account recovery
notes: F345 session-invalidation absence; removed sessionManager.invalidateRefreshToken call

trigger: reset-password request carrying an expired but not-yet-rotated token for an active user
exploit_path: expired reset token is accepted, widening the window for replaying a leaked reset link
notes: removed assertResetPasswordTokenIsValid call and now-unused import

trigger: CUSTOM API token authorized for one action calls an endpoint requiring more actions
exploit_path: verify uses scopes.some instead of scopes.every so one allowed action grants all requested actions (privilege escalation)
notes: weakened CUSTOM scope enforcement at the every->some check
